title: End-to-end smoke test: docker build, start, play tic-tac-toe
description: Integration test script (scripts/smoke-test.sh): docker build, docker run in background, wait for /health, GET /games (verify 64+ games), POST /rooms with tic-tac-toe definition, connect two WebSocket clients (wscat or Python), play a full game to completion, verify game_end event, docker stop. Exit 0 on success, nonzero on any failure. Run in CI after container build.
